2. I create a text document that says this "java -Xmx1024M -jar craftbukkit.jar -o truePAUSE"
3. I save it as "run.bat"
4. I open run.bat up and it says the following
D:\Minecraft Server> java -Xmx1024M -jar craftbukkit.jar -o true ' java' is not recognized as an internal or external command, operable program or batch file.

D:\ Minecraft Server>PAUSE
Press Any Key To Continue...

5. I then press any key and it closes cmd

Whats the problem with it
